question: What seed-mantra forms are attributed to the praised goddess Kālī?
premises: Kālī is described as having the form of her own seed.
She is also described as having the form of the kāma seed.
inference: The goddess is identified with both her own seed-mantra and the kāma seed-mantra.
plain_english: She is of the nature of her own seed and of the nature of the kāma seed.
